name: Samsung Pyeongtaek P3

process_nodes.label: 5nm
process_nodes.note: EUV-based foundry production at 5nm or below was planned at the line after its first NAND output, subject to demand.

summary: The third production line at Samsung's Pyeongtaek campus in Gyeonggi Province. Earthworks started in July 2020 on a line that Korea JoongAng Daily said would cost around KRW 30 trillion, with mass production then expected by 2023. The line came on stream in July 2022 with NAND flash among its first products, and Samsung showed it to the press that September; EUV-based DRAM and foundry production at 5nm or below were to be added as demand warranted. Press reports called P3 Samsung's largest fab, at about 700,000 m².

metrics.note: Figure reported by Korea JoongAng Daily when groundwork began; Samsung declined to comment on construction details.

milestones.note: A city official said earthworks began in July 2020 after building approval in June.
Mass production target reported when groundwork began.
Samsung said the line started operating in July 2022 with wafer input under way; NAND flash was among the first products.
